entities.name: Debaryomyces TIM50 Q6BVY9
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed UniProt Q6BVY9, mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit TIM50.
Annotated as a TIM23-complex component involved in mitochondrial preprotein import; localization is mitochondrial inner membrane, single-pass.
Sequence is 471 aa, estimated mass 54.19 kDa, theoretical pI 6.11; Pfam NIF domain at residues 190–337.
